$comment: Narration cues. start = where the trimmed line file begins (seconds on the 120 BPM grid in cues/beats.json; speech onset is ~0.08 s later). maxEnd = hard end of the line's window. targetSec = planned natural read. The approved take for each line is vo/<id>.wav (native 24 kHz Gemini TTS master). Never time-stretch a take; re-read it or move the picture instead. 'WinMux' is pronounced WIN-mux.

lines.text: Every project brings its own windows.
Soon, you're searching more than working.
lines.beat: windows pile up; wry, not grim

lines.text: Meet WinMux, a tiling window manager for your Mac.
lines.beat: just after the snap; warm introduction

lines.text: In the sidebar, every workspace is a tab, one click away.
lines.beat: camera on the sidebar; 'one click away' lands on the Roadmap click at 28.5 s

lines.text: Projects keep each context apart. Switch, and the sidebar follows.
lines.beat: 'Switch' lands on the project switch at 33.0 s; back to Launch at 35.5 s

lines.text: Group related tabs, and fold away the rest.
Pin the ones you always come back to.

lines.beat: right after the displays reveal at 48.0 s

lines.text: Drag a tab, and your other displays appear as rails.
lines.beat: rails slide in at 54.0 s, near 'appear'

lines.text: Pause to open its list. Drop, and it's there.
lines.beat: rail tints 57.0 s; list opens 58.0 s; 'Drop' lands on the drop at 59.5 s

lines.text: Click one, and it comes to your screen.
lines.beat: 'Click' lands on the click at 65.0 s; the window arrives at 67.0 s

lines.text: A subtle badge marks the ones on other displays.
Reorder them anywhere. No window changes screens.

lines.beat: logo landed at 78.0 s; final chord at 82.0 s
